description: Estimate what a swap would return right now: the best route across the indexed DEX pools, amount out (decimal-adjusted), effective price, price impact (percent) and the smallest pool liquidity on the route (ADA). It never builds, signs or submits a transaction: the result includes `swapUrl`, a link the user opens to review the trade and sign it in their own wallet.

amount.description: Amount of tokenIn to sell, decimal-adjusted (100 = 100 ADA when tokenIn is ADA).

tokenIn.description: What is sold: a token unit, or "lovelace" / "ADA" for ADA.

tokenOut.description: What is bought: a token unit, or "lovelace" / "ADA" for ADA.

name: get_swap_quote
title: Swap quote (no trade is made)
